# Step - trim

`trim` · category: [Strings and type conversion](../../traversal/step_reference.md#strings-and-type-conversion)

Removes leading and trailing whitespace (Unicode White_Space, see the book page Type Conversion and length()) from each string.

## Forms

```text
trim()
trim(arg1: Scope)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.inject("  a  ").trim().next()   // a
```

## See also

- [Type Conversion](../../users_guide/type_conversion.md)
